_comment: The character set the three CJK subset pairs carry (plan T-419 decision 8, ja and ko added by plan T-452 decision 3, the Traditional pair retired with its catalog by plan T-537): each subset is cut with fontTools over the closed string set - every character of its CJK catalog, its native-strings.json row, its widget-statics.json row, its endonym, and the What's New keys that resolve through the catalog - and this lock is generated from the subsets' own cmaps, so shared/__tests__/cjkSubset.test.ts names any byte the subsets miss or the strings drop. files binds the committed binaries by sha256 so a re-cut shipping stale TTFs cannot pass the gate. Regenerate from the repo root with the full statics fetched OUTSIDE the repository (decision 8): node scripts/cjk-subset.mjs <dir> (see the script header for the three curl lines).
